_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco interfaces and modules, 14 Sep 2026. This category is the single home for router interface cards (layers review 14 Sep 2026, item 7; docs/decisions/2026-09-14-sp-router-roles.md §3): the 'Router Interface Modules' series carry the SAME names as the routers mapping, so the 500 planned arrivals land in the series they already had. Catalyst 4500 line cards, MDS modules, AP and ASA modules, the XGS-PON ONTs and Small Business power adapters belong to other categories (not this category, with reasons). No role axis.

not_this_category.why: MDS 9000 Fibre Channel line card, fabric or supervisor module
access point add-on module (Wireless Security and Spectrum Intelligence / Hyperlocation) or its antenna
Catalyst PON XGS-PON ONT (an endpoint device, not a module)
Small Business switch / WAP power adapter
ASR 1000 Ethernet Port Adapter: bound to one platform, which lives in routers (layers review A.3, rule 1)
Grid Router Interface Card: CGR 2010 only (A.3, rule 1)
Connected Grid Module: CGR 1000 only (A.3, rule 1)
Cisco 7300 line card: bound to the 7300, which lives in routers (A.3, rule 1)
Connected Grid (CGR 1000) WiMAX panel antenna / connector, filed under the Connected Grid Modules label: bound to the CGR, which lives in routers (A.3 rule 1)

Catalyst 6500 / 7600 service module (ASA-SM, NAM-3, IDSM-2, WebVPN, ACE30) or its memory / disk: a platform-bound card, kept with the platform in switches under Catalyst 6500 (layers review round 2 decision (14 Sep 2026); A.3 rule 1)

series.note: multi-platform router cards (A.3 rule 1). Patterns that match no row here yet (C-NIM, C-SM, UCS-E, ISM/EM, WIC, P-LTE/5G, WP, MC/PCEX/WIM) are for the rows planned to move in from routers, switches and unified-communications

series.series: Cisco 12000 / XR 12000 SIP and line cards

series.note: what is left once the Catalyst 6500 / 7600 service modules moved to switches (layers review round 2 decision (14 Sep 2026)): NAM2420-K9 / NAM2440-K9 are standalone Network Analysis Module appliances filed under the "Services Modules" label — their category is a question for the interfaces-modules round

series.series: Router and switch line cards (legacy) shared parts
labels: Route Processors and Route Switch Processors
